name: Ivra Jursdotter
description: Speaker doubting goblins can be taught to throw grenades.

description_citations.text: Anthologies: card flavor text (Anthologies, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ivra Jursdotter recalls an ogre turning on its commander.
timeline.quote: "We were holding our own—until the ogre guiding us suddenly grinned and turned on our commander."

citation.text: Ghazbán Ogre (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ivra Jursdotter wonders whether goblins can be taught to throw grenades.
timeline.quote: I don't suppose we could teach them to throw the cursed things?

citation.text: Goblin Grenade (Anthologies, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
